"""Intent tests for runlog.progress (M1-T11, PL-04, LOG-06)."""

import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from rllab.runlog import Progress, progress

FIXTURE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "fixtures" / "rllab" / "TC-14"


def _run_path(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    spec = json.loads((FIXTURE / "input.json").read_text())
    src = FIXTURE / spec["run"]
    dst = tmp_path / "run"
    shutil.copytree(src, dst)
    return dst


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc14_progress_reads_latest_evaluation_point(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    expected = json.loads((FIXTURE / "expected.json").read_text())
    snapshot = progress(_run_path(tmp_path))
    assert isinstance(snapshot, Progress)
    assert snapshot.step == expected["step"]
    assert snapshot.budget == expected["budget"]
    assert snapshot.latest is not None
    assert snapshot.latest.step == expected["latest_step"]
    assert snapshot.status == expected["status"]


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_progress_missing_run_raises_file_not_found(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError, match="."):
        progress(tmp_path / "no-such-run")
